'''2012 Bespin Regionals Nick Rambo LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nick Rambo]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
